pre-commit.name: Check for hardcoded secrets
pre-commit.command: ! grep -r 'API_KEY\|api_key\|PASSWORD\|password\|TOKEN\|token' mpcamera/ --include='*.py' | grep -v '.pyc' || echo 'No hardcoded secrets found'

pre-commit.name: Validate PyInstaller spec
pre-commit.command: python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('SoilSight.spec').read()); print('PyInstaller spec is valid')"

post-checkout.command: test requirements.txt -nt .venv311/pyvenv.cfg 2>/dev/null && echo 'Installing dependencies...' && pip install -r requirements.txt || echo 'Dependencies are up to date'
